title: Entry marginal of the joint Rademacher measure
statement: Let $\mathrm{Rad} = \tfrac{1}{2}\delta_{-1} + \tfrac{1}{2}\delta_{+1}$ be the Rademacher distribution on $\bbr$, and let $\mu$ be the product measure on the space of $k \times d$ real arrays $\omega = (\omega_{ij})$ under which all $k \cdot d$ entries are independent and $\mathrm{Rad}$-distributed. Then for every index $(i,j) \in \mathrm{Fin}\,k \times \mathrm{Fin}\,d$, the pushforward of $\mu$ along the coordinate projection $\omega \mapsto \omega_{ij}$ is exactly $\mathrm{Rad}$.
hypotheses_covered: fixed row index i ∈ Fin k
fixed column index j ∈ Fin d
μ is the joint Rademacher product measure on k×d arrays
replaced:
The pushforward of the joint measure along the $(i,j)$-entry projection
$\omega \mapsto \omega_{ij}$ equals $\mathrm{Rad}$.
